notes.title: Jack B. Nimble released!
notes.notes:
Jack B. Nimble is now available on Steam for Mac and PC, and for one week only, you can purchase Jack B. Nimble at a [b]25% discount[/b]*!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LWP6MzXsODk [i]*Discount ends July 31st.[/i]

Thanks,
Noonan

notes.title: Jack B. Nimble launches July 24th, 2018
notes.notes:
I'm happy to reveal the release date of Jack B. Nimble for Steam. The game will be launching for PC and Mac on July 24th at the price of $2.99 / £1.99 / €2.99

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32682080/0d95258643f6248a0d27d8c0d7aee06924d6e5b8.gif[/img] 

Here's the announcement tweet: https://twitter.com/SeanNoonan/status/1019351256429748224

The game is already out to curators. If you are a curator and would like an early look at Jack B. Nimble, contact me via this form: http://noonan.design/contact/

Thanks,
Noonan
